name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Pinehollow goes with exactly two of Cody, Pike, Jig, and Nightcrawler.
The angler using the Spinnerbait belongs to the Pike Family.
The angler at Pinehollow and Esther are in different families.
The angler at Foxglen and Esther are in different families.
Carp goes with exactly three of Boone, Pinehollow, Swimbait, and Nightcrawler.
Exactly one of the angler who landed the Carp and the angler who landed the Pike belongs to the East Watershed.
Willowmere, Buzzbait, and Shrimp belong to different catches.
The angler using the Jig belongs to the Pike Family.
The angler using the Spinnerbait and the angler fishing with Corn are in the same watershed.
Mabel does not belong to the South Watershed.
